sn_aia_tool.description: Use this tool to send the official branded fraud case confirmation email to the customer contact. Pushes the AI suggested summary into 'x_snc_pab_ee_tkit_ai_suggested_response' on the fraud case and dispatches the templated security alert with card restriction details and portal tracking link.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"case_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the created fraud case","mandatory":true},{"name":"contact_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the customer contact","mandatory":false},{"name":"ai_suggested_response","description":"The summary response to include in the confirmation email","mandatory":false}]
sn_aia_tool.name: send_fraud_case_confirmation_email
